PS-0283.summary_en: At the US-convened critical minerals ministerial where Argentina moved to join the US-launched preferential trade zone, Quirno said Argentina is committed to deepening critical-minerals cooperation with the US and secure supply chains.
PS-0283.quote_original: Argentina está comprometida en profundizar la cooperación con los Estados Unidos en materia de minerales críticos, apoyando cadenas de suministro seguras
PS-0283.quote_en: Argentina is committed to deepening cooperation with the United States on critical minerals, supporting secure supply chains

PS-0125.event_context: Visit to Albemarle lithium plant, La Negra (Antofagasta)
PS-0125.summary_en: At Albemarle's plant Yellen said the US wants to acquire minerals from free-trade partners like Chile and expected US lithium purchases from Chile to expand substantially, while saying expanding trade with Chile is 'not a competition' with China, though reducing over-dependence on China is core to the IRA.
PS-0125.quote_original: We want to certainly acquire minerals from our free trade partners, especially a country like Chile that is producing with great environmental sensitivity
PS-0125.quote_en: We want to certainly acquire minerals from our free trade partners, especially a country like Chile that is producing with great environmental sensitivity

speaker.name: Hugo de Zela
speaker.role: Minister of Foreign Affairs of Peru

PS-0290.event_context: Critical Minerals Ministerial, Washington D.C.; Peru-US MoU
PS-0290.summary_en: De Zela signed a non-binding Peru-US memorandum of understanding on critical minerals in Washington, framed as enabling joint identification of priority projects and access to US financial and technological instruments for exploration, processing and recycling.
PS-0290.quote_original: The agreement facilitates the joint identification of priority projects, as well as access to financial and technological instruments that will contribute to boosting new investments.
PS-0290.quote_en: The agreement facilitates the joint identification of priority projects, as well as access to financial and technological instruments that will contribute to boosting new investments.
PS-0290.notes: Andina is the state news agency; quote is official English version (may be ministry wording rather than minister's own)

PS-0101.summary_en: Richardson stressed the hemisphere's natural resource wealth, including the lithium triangle's ~60% of global lithium reserves and copper, and characterized PRC investment in the region as extraction rather than investment.
PS-0101.quote_original: what the PRC is doing – the People's Republic of China – looks to be investment but really I call it extraction
PS-0101.quote_en: what the PRC is doing – the People's Republic of China – looks to be investment but really I call it extraction

PS-0354.event_context: Testimony to House Appropriations Subcommittee on National Security, Department of State and Related Programs
PS-0354.summary_en: Discussing China in the Americas, Rubio said Beijing seeks access to critical minerals and mining through long-term contracts and infrastructure investments, and that countries turn to Chinese firms because they are the only ones showing up, requiring US alternatives.
PS-0354.quote_original: They try to establish for themselves access to critical minerals, mining of any sort and gain these long-term contracts
PS-0354.quote_en: They try to establish for themselves access to critical minerals, mining of any sort and gain these long-term contracts

speaker.name: Michael Kozak
speaker.role: Senior Bureau Official, Bureau of Western Hemisphere Affairs, U.S. Department of State

PS-0363.event_context: SFRC Western Hemisphere subcommittee hearing 'The National Security Strategy and the Western Hemisphere'
PS-0363.summary_en: Kozak told senators the US had signed seven cooperative critical-minerals MOUs in the hemisphere to speed resource development and was pushing US and allied firms into critical infrastructure to push out competitors; he also accused China of economic retaliation against Panama.
PS-0363.quote_original: On critical minerals, we have signed seven cooperative MOUs that will speed up resource development.
PS-0363.quote_en: On critical minerals, we have signed seven cooperative MOUs that will speed up resource development.

source.name: U.S. Senate Foreign Relations Committee (written testimony)

PS-0363.notes: Countries of the seven MOUs not named in testimony.

PS-0298.event_context: Press conference after US-Argentina critical minerals and reciprocal trade agreements
PS-0298.summary_en: Quirno said the agreements with the US do not prevent China from participating in Argentine investments, noting China already has mineral investments in the country, while the pact prioritizes the US over market-manipulating economies.
PS-0298.quote_original: Esto, a hoy, no implica que China no pueda participar o no vaya a participar en inversiones en Argentina. De hecho, tiene inversiones en Argentina, en minerales
PS-0298.quote_en: This, as of today, does not mean China cannot or will not participate in investments in Argentina. In fact, it has investments in Argentina, in minerals

speaker.name: Daniel González
speaker.role: Coordinating Secretary of Energy and Mining of Argentina

PS-0338.event_context: Signing of joint statement with US Chamber of Commerce/AmCham on minerals
PS-0338.related_entities: AmCham Argentina; US Chamber of Commerce
PS-0338.summary_en: González said the copper had always been there but was not developed, and that Argentina is again macroeconomically ordered and aligned with the West, crediting Milei for taking on the issue.
PS-0338.quote_original: Volvimos a ser un país más ordenado macroeconómicamente y alineado con Occidente
PS-0338.quote_en: We are once again a more macroeconomically orderly country aligned with the West

PS-0240.event_context: South American Defense Conference, Buenos Aires
PS-0240.summary_en: Speaking in Buenos Aires, Holsey warned that the Chinese Communist Party is methodically advancing in the region to extract resources and build dual-use infrastructure from ports to space.
PS-0240.quote_original: El Partido Comunista Chino continúa su incursión metódica en la región, buscando exportar su modelo autoritario
PS-0240.quote_en: The Chinese Communist Party continues its methodical incursion in the region, seeking to export its authoritarian model
PS-0240.notes: Quote is Spanish rendering of English remarks; resource extraction mentioned generically

PS-0118.summary_en: Milei said Elon Musk is extremely interested in Argentine lithium, as are the US government and many companies, and argued Argentina needs a legal framework that respects property rights to attract them.
PS-0118.quote_original: está sumamente interesado en el litio
PS-0118.quote_en: he is extremely interested in lithium

PS-0120.event_context: Bloomberg Línea interview early in Milei government
PS-0120.summary_en: Royón said Argentina should pursue lithium, copper, gold and silver alike, that copper must be a national objective, that lithium industrialization matters but should not be exclusionary, and that talks with the State Department on Argentina's IRA inclusion continue.
PS-0120.quote_original: Acá no es litio o cobre. Es el litio, cobre, oro, plata, todo.
PS-0120.quote_en: Here it is not lithium or copper. It is lithium, copper, gold, silver, everything.

speaker.name: Marco Rubio
speaker.role: U.S. Senator (R-FL), Ranking Member, SFRC Subcommittee on the Western Hemisphere

PS-0032.event_context: SFRC Western Hemisphere subcommittee hearing 'China's Role in Latin America and the Caribbean'
PS-0032.summary_en: Rubio said the Chinese Communist Party pushes Latin American countries to stay dependent on mining and natural-resource exports rather than helping them develop and industrialize.
PS-0032.quote_original: the Chinese Communist Party is pushing countries to remain dependent on mining and other—and the export of other natural resources
PS-0032.quote_en: the Chinese Communist Party is pushing countries to remain dependent on mining and other—and the export of other natural resources

source.name: U.S. Senate Foreign Relations Committee (hearing transcript)

PS-0032.notes: Ranking-member role inferred, not confirmed on page.

speaker.name: Tim Kaine
speaker.role: U.S. Senator (D-VA), Chair, SFRC Subcommittee on the Western Hemisphere

PS-0033.event_context: SFRC Western Hemisphere subcommittee hearing 'China's Role in Latin America and the Caribbean'
PS-0033.summary_en: In his opening statement Kaine said China continues its quest for natural resources and raw materials across Latin America, citing lithium in Argentina, Bolivia and Chile and copper in Peru.
PS-0033.quote_original: China continues its quest for natural resources and raw materials throughout the region, including lithium in places like Argentina, Bolivia, and Chile or copper in Peru.
PS-0033.quote_en: China continues its quest for natural resources and raw materials throughout the region, including lithium in places like Argentina, Bolivia, and Chile or copper in Peru.

source.name: U.S. Senate Foreign Relations Committee (hearing transcript)

PS-0033.notes: Subcommittee chair role inferred (Kaine chaired the WH subcommittee in the 117th Congress).

PS-0046.summary_en: Richardson described the region as rich in resources, rare earth minerals and lithium, noting the lithium triangle lies in the hemisphere.
PS-0046.quote_original: This region is so rich in resources, rare earth minerals, lithium — the lithium triangle is in this region.
PS-0046.quote_en: This region is so rich in resources, rare earth minerals, lithium — the lithium triangle is in this region.
PS-0046.notes: Quote transcribed by a blog from Concordia livestream; not checked against video

PS-0059.summary_en: SOUTHCOM commander said Latin America matters to US security because of its resources, citing the 'lithium triangle' of Argentina, Bolivia and Chile with about 60% of world lithium, plus rare earth elements, oil and fresh water, and said the US must step up its game against adversaries.
PS-0059.quote_original: Why this region matters with all its rich resource and rare earth elements, you've got the lithium triangle which is needed for technology today.
PS-0059.quote_en: Why this region matters with all its rich resource and rare earth elements, you've got the lithium triangle which is needed for technology today.
PS-0059.notes: Quote as reported by Buenos Aires Herald; Spanish coverage (Conclusión https://www.conclusion.com.ar/?p=985547) adds '60% of the world's lithium is in the lithium triangle'.

PS-0062.summary_en: The SOUTHCOM commander highlighted that about 60% of the world's lithium lies in the 'lithium triangle' of Argentina, Bolivia and Chile, framing the region's resources as strategically important to the US.
PS-0062.notes: Quote as rendered by secondary source (may be back-translated); region-wide statement naming Bolivia. Quote cleared: only translated wording seen.

PS-0065.summary_en: The 2023 posture statement warned that the PRC has expanded its ability to extract resources, establish ports and manipulate governments through predatory investment in the region.
PS-0065.quote_original: The PRC has expanded its ability to extract resources, establish ports, manipulate governments through predatory investment practices
PS-0065.quote_en: The PRC has expanded its ability to extract resources, establish ports, manipulate governments through predatory investment practices

PS-0066.event_context: House Armed Services Committee hearing on SOUTHCOM posture
PS-0066.summary_en: Testifying to the House, Richardson said the region is full of resources exploited by adversaries who appear to invest but actually extract, and described China's lithium game in the region as very advanced and aggressive.
PS-0066.quote_original: la agresividad de China y su juego en el terreno con el litio, es muy avanzado y muy agresivo
PS-0066.quote_en: China's aggressiveness and its game on the ground with lithium is very advanced and very aggressive
PS-0066.notes: Spanish rendering of English testimony; also reported by El Ciudadano https://www.elciudadano.com/?p=942911 (dated 10 Mar 2023)

PS-0067.event_context: Senate Armed Services Committee hearing on NORTHCOM/SOUTHCOM posture
PS-0067.summary_en: Testifying to the Senate, Richardson said the PRC has expanded its ability to extract resources from the region and gets 75 percent of its lithium from South America.
PS-0067.quote_original: The PRC has expanded its ability to extract resources, and gets 36 percent of its food imports from the region and 75 percent of its lithium from South America.
PS-0067.quote_en: The PRC has expanded its ability to extract resources, and gets 36 percent of its food imports from the region and 75 percent of its lithium from South America.

PS-0069.event_context: Proposed guidance on IRA clean vehicle credit (Section 30D) critical minerals requirement
PS-0069.summary_en: Treasury's proposed IRA guidance listed free-trade-agreement countries, including Chile, Colombia, Mexico, Panama and Peru, whose extracted or processed critical minerals count toward the EV credit's rising sourcing thresholds (40% in 2023 to 80% from 2027).
PS-0069.notes: Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil not FTA partners (excluded unless new critical minerals agreement)

speaker.name: José W. Fernández
speaker.role: U.S. Under Secretary of State for Economic Growth, Energy, and the Environment

PS-0099.event_context: Senate Foreign Relations Committee hearing 'U.S. Economic Security: Addressing Economic Coercion and Increasing Competitiveness'
PS-0099.summary_en: Asked about growing Brazil-China mineral and EV ties, Fernández told senators the US must get more involved in the hemisphere's critical minerals, naming Brazil, Argentina, Chile and Peru, and cited the Minerals Security Partnership as the response.
PS-0099.quote_original: Brazil could be a very valuable partner in finding critical minerals. It's not only Brazil. Argentina, Chile, Peru — we've got to do more in this hemisphere.
PS-0099.quote_en: Brazil could be a very valuable partner in finding critical minerals. It's not only Brazil. Argentina, Chile, Peru — we've got to do more in this hemisphere.
PS-0099.notes: Hearing date 26 Jul 2023 confirmed on foreign.senate.gov; Bloomberg Línea version dated 27 Jul. Written testimony: https://www.foreign.senate.gov/download/072623_fernandez_testimony

PS-0106.summary_en: Richardson again cited the lithium triangle's 60% of world lithium plus copper and gold, and said the US must ensure adversaries and strategic competitors are not going to the region to extract for nefarious reasons; she criticized BRI projects as debt traps.
PS-0106.quote_original: you want to make sure that adversaries and strategic competitors aren't trying to go there for nefarious reasons to extract
PS-0106.quote_en: you want to make sure that adversaries and strategic competitors aren't trying to go there for nefarious reasons to extract

source.name: Foundation for Defense of Democracies (event transcript)

PS-0129.summary_en: SOUTHCOM's 2024 posture statement listed lithium, rare earths and minerals among goods trafficked by transnational criminal organizations in the hemisphere.
PS-0129.quote_original: traffic weapons, drugs, people gold, lithium, rare earth, minerals, commodities and counterfeit goods
PS-0129.quote_en: traffic weapons, drugs, people gold, lithium, rare earth, minerals, commodities and counterfeit goods

PS-0175.event_context: SOUTHCOM 2025 Posture Statement to Senate Armed Services Committee
PS-0175.summary_en: Holsey's posture statement said China is 'plowing fertile ground' in a region holding half the world's lithium reserves and a quarter of strategic metals, and that Chinese SOEs dominate rare earth mining and refining and use BRI to gain access to rare earths and ports.
PS-0175.quote_original: Fifty percent of the world's lithium reserves are found in Argentina, Bolivia, and Chile.
PS-0175.quote_en: Fifty percent of the world's lithium reserves are found in Argentina, Bolivia, and Chile.
PS-0175.notes: Written statement dated 13 Feb 2025 (SASC); also delivered to HASC 1 Apr 2025.

speaker.name: China-CELAC Forum (Fourth Ministerial Meeting)
speaker.role: Joint document of China and CELAC member states

PS-0192.event_context: China-CELAC Forum Fourth Ministerial Meeting, Beijing; Joint Action Plan 2025-2027
PS-0192.summary_en: The China-CELAC Joint Action Plan 2025-2027 contains an 'Energy and resources' chapter that commits to exploring investment in energy transition and advanced energy storage and to geoscience cooperation; it names no specific minerals. Its law-enforcement section calls for exchanges on combating illegal mining and illegal trade in precious metals.
PS-0192.quote_original: 探索双方能源转型与先进储能技术合作投资机遇，助力双方共同实现能源绿色低碳转型。
PS-0192.quote_en: Explore cooperation and investment opportunities in energy transition and advanced energy storage technology, helping both sides achieve a green, low-carbon energy transition.

source.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC

PS-0192.notes: No explicit lithium/copper language; Spanish version: static.poder360.com.br/2025/05/plano-de-acao-china-latina.pdf. Joint China-CELAC text, coded as china_central_gov.

PS-0227.event_context: Proclamation 'Adjusting Imports of Copper into the United States' (Section 232)
PS-0227.summary_en: Trump imposed a 50% Section 232 tariff on semi-finished copper products and intensive derivatives from 1 August 2025 while leaving ores, concentrates and cathodes out, citing a single foreign country's dominance of global smelting and refining.
PS-0227.quote_original: Today, a single foreign country dominates global copper smelting and refining, controlling over 50 percent of global smelting capacity
PS-0227.quote_en: Today, a single foreign country dominates global copper smelting and refining, controlling over 50 percent of global smelting capacity
PS-0227.notes: Global measure, no LatAm country named; relevant to Chile/Peru as main copper suppliers; cathode exclusion reported by CTV/Reuters https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/trumps-tariffs/article/trump-imposes-50-tariff-on-copper-imports-white-house-says/ . 'Single foreign country' implicitly China (not named).

speaker.name: Guo Jiakun
speaker.role: Spokesperson, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China

PS-0243.event_context: Response to SOUTHCOM commander's remarks at South American Defense Conference in Argentina
PS-0243.summary_en: Responding to the US Southern Command chief's claim in Argentina that China was infiltrating the Western Hemisphere and grabbing resources, Guo Jiakun said the US has long interfered in and sought to control Latin America and that the region is nobody's backyard.
PS-0243.quote_original: 拉美和加勒比不是谁的后院，中拉合作不针对第三方，也不应受到第三方的干扰。
PS-0243.quote_en: Latin America and the Caribbean is nobody's backyard; China-LAC cooperation does not target any third party and should not be interfered with by any third party.
PS-0243.notes: US remark referred to 'resources' generally, not a specific mineral; borderline relevance. MFA transcript not fetched.

speaker.name: The White House (Trump administration)
speaker.role: National Security Strategy of the United States

PS-0263.event_context: 2025 National Security Strategy, 'Trump Corollary' to the Monroe Doctrine
PS-0263.summary_en: The NSS says the Western Hemisphere holds strategic resources the US should develop with regional allies, orders an interagency process to identify strategic points and resources for protection and joint development, and pledges to deny non-Hemispheric competitors ownership or control of strategically vital assets.
PS-0263.quote_original: The Western Hemisphere is home to many strategic resources that America should partner with regional allies to develop
PS-0263.quote_en: The Western Hemisphere is home to many strategic resources that America should partner with regional allies to develop
PS-0263.notes: Document dated November 2025, published early December 2025; China implied as 'non-Hemispheric competitor' (stance inferred)

speaker.name: Government of the People's Republic of China
speaker.role: Central government (policy paper issued via Xinhua)

PS-0267.event_context: Third China's Policy Paper on Latin America and the Caribbean
PS-0267.summary_en: China's third policy paper on LAC, under its energy and resources cooperation section, pledges full-industrial-chain energy cooperation and green development and use of mineral resources across all stages. It also proposes mechanisms for long-term supply of energy and resource products with local-currency pricing and settlement.
PS-0267.quote_original: 加强矿产资源各环节绿色开发利用
PS-0267.quote_en: Strengthen the green development and utilization of mineral resources across all links
PS-0267.notes: Section (五) 能源资源合作; full text published by Xinhua; English version referenced at english.www.gov.cn content_WS693962c3c6d00ca5f9a08069

speaker.name: U.S. Department of State
speaker.role: Host of 2026 Critical Minerals Ministerial (Sec. Marco Rubio)

PS-0292.summary_en: State Department fact sheet on the ministerial hosted by Rubio and VP Vance listed attending delegations including Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Ecuador, Paraguay and Peru, new bilateral critical minerals frameworks/MOUs with Argentina, Ecuador, Paraguay and Peru, and $565 million for rare earth extraction in Brazil.
PS-0292.notes: Fact sheet reproduced by GlobalSecurity; 'other' = Paraguay

PS-0296.event_context: Close of 2026 Critical Minerals Ministerial; 11 bilateral frameworks incl. Argentina, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru
PS-0296.summary_en: Rubio said the US and partners took a decisive step to reshape the global critical minerals and rare earths market, as 11 new bilateral agreements were signed including with Argentina, Ecuador, Paraguay and Peru.
PS-0296.quote_original: took a decisive step to reshape the global market for critical minerals and rare earths, strengthening supply chains that underpin the world's most advanced technologies
PS-0296.quote_en: took a decisive step to reshape the global market for critical minerals and rare earths, strengthening supply chains that underpin the world's most advanced technologies

speaker.name: Máximo Pacheco
speaker.role: Chairman of NovaAndino Litio (former Codelco chairman)

PS-0347.event_context: Resignation letter from NovaAndino Litio board
PS-0347.summary_en: Pacheco resigned as chair of the Codelco-SQM lithium JV after pressure from the Kast government and Republican deputies, accusing some sectors of placing narrow partisanship above national interest.
PS-0347.quote_original: Para algunos la reducida bandería política vale más que el interés nacional
PS-0347.quote_en: For some, narrow political partisanship is worth more than the national interest

speaker.name: Guillermo Shinno
speaker.role: Minister of Energy and Mines of Peru

PS-0389.event_context: After Rubio visit; Chinese and US firms seeking copper projects
PS-0389.summary_en: Shinno said interest from investors is enormous, that new projects could add a million tonnes of annual copper output in five to six years, that 27 permits could be eliminated without lowering environmental standards, and that he hoped more US companies would come.
PS-0389.quote_original: We hope that more American companies will be encouraged to come.
PS-0389.quote_en: We hope that more American companies will be encouraged to come.
